components.name: Primary Pill Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: var(--apple-blue, #0071e3); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 980px; min-height: 42px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0077ed; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Outline Pill Button
components.description: Secondary action button with 1px Apple link blue outline.

narrative.overview: Eve adopts the spatial architecture, typographic authority, and tactile restraint of Apple's official website (apple.com). Instead of dense admin chrome or nested Bootstrap boxes, every page is structured as a sequence of full-bleed alternating chapters—pure white editorial stages (#ffffff) paired with warm aluminum-gray Bento canvases (#f5f5f7 in Daylight, #000000 / #161617 in Pro Dark).
keyCharacteristics: 44px frosted-glass GlobalNav paired with 52px sticky LocalSubNav chapter bars
Asymmetric 12-column Bento grids (8 + 4 and 7 + 5 spans) with zero nested cards
Hairline specification strips (.apple-spec-strip) and clean horizontal row lists (.apple-row-list)
Tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) across all dates, shift windows, and telemetry counters

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Apple Interactive Blue (#0071e3) appears only on actionable controls and live progress indicators—never as decorative card borders or background fills.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: All functional text, including 12px captions and input placeholders, maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast against both #ffffff surfaces and #f5f5f7 canvases.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels above them; the headline's scale and phrasing establish context on their own.

rules.name: The Zero-Nested-Box Rule
rules.body: Cards and Bento tiles never contain smaller bordered cards inside them; internal metadata is separated strictly with 1px hairline specification strips (.apple-spec-strip).

dos: Do alternate .apple-section-white and .apple-section-canvas to create clear chapter transitions across long pages.
Do use .apple-spec-strip and .apple-row-list with 1px hairlines (--apple-divider) to organize metadata without adding box clutter.
Do keep all functional UI text at 11px or larger and interactive touch targets at 36px–44px minimum height.
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above headings.
Don't nest bordered cards or shaded boxes inside .apple-tile containers.
Don't use 4 equal-width icon+heading+blurb cards as a page scaffold; use asymmetric Bento spans (8+4, 7+5, 6+6) or horizontal row lists instead.
